Monument to Balzac by Auguste Rodin

Honoré de Balzac was a French writer, considered one of the founders of realism in European literature.

Monument to Balzac is a sculpture by Auguste Rodin in his memory. According to Rodin, the sculpture aims to portray the writer’s persona rather than a physical likeness. The sculpture was not received well by the critics. Many disliked the grotesque stature of the figure while others criticized the work to be very similar to that of the Italian impressionist Medardo Rosso.
